processing.method: Preview-derived approximate ground cap from regular XY bins over the existing Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity model preview.
processing.downsampling: Derived from the 90,000-point MT preview, not the full-density model. Grid/bin and smoothing parameters are review-sensitive.
processing.masking: Sparse/deep exterior bins are rejected; only the largest connected upper component is retained, with one local edge dilation allowed.
processing.notes: Surface intentionally avoids sparse-column top triangulation because that creates vertical icicle sheets.
